CanonicalIngressRequest.description: Strict canonical-only request for creating a PlanningRun. Authentication, effective authorization and Extension selection are server-owned and intentionally absent.
CanonicalIngressRequest.title: PlantNexus APS Canonical Ingress Request v1

CanonicalIngressResult.description: Server-owned acceptance or zero-side-effect rejection result. HTTP status mapping is outside this document and belongs to TASK-P8-07.
CanonicalIngressResult.title: PlantNexus APS Canonical Ingress Result v1

CanonicalRecordsV1.description: Authority-neutral canonical APS entity collections. Source mappings and production values remain external, versioned inputs.
CanonicalRecordsV1.title: PlantNexus APS Canonical Records v1

DynamicReplanningResponseEnvelope.description: Stable transport envelope around one application-owned result.
DynamicReplanningResponseEnvelope.title: DynamicReplanningResponseEnvelope

ImportPackageV2.description: Strict canonical import envelope. Source mapping remains adapter-owned and every normalization/canonicalization version is explicit.
ImportPackageV2.title: PlantNexus APS Standard Import Package v2

PlanningRun.description: Authoritative PlanningRun lifecycle carrier aligned exactly with state-machines.v1. It represents state and evidence but executes no transition.
PlanningRun.title: PlantNexus APS PlanningRun v1

PlanningWorkspaceErrorEnvelope.description: Stable public error shape; internal exception text is never serialized.
PlanningWorkspaceErrorEnvelope.title: PlanningWorkspaceErrorEnvelope

ReplanAttemptActionDocument.description: HTTP-only CAS command; it never gives ReplanRequest a state machine.
ReplanAttemptActionDocument.title: ReplanAttemptActionDocument
